description: Query prior captured and compiled knowledge. Results must carry provenance so every recalled item traces back to its original source.

expects.description: A query intent has been formed (keyword terms, topic, or semantic vector). The query scope (captured sources, compiled insights, or both) must be specified.
Results matching the query have been retrieved from the knowledge store. An empty result set is valid; retrieval failure or timeout is not.

Every non-empty result carries a provenance reference back to its originating captured source (source_id or source_ref). Results without traceable provenance must be excluded before this gate can pass.
